# SITEWORK/HAZ

> HAZWOPER training for construction crews on brownfields, landfills and contaminated excavations: 40-hour construction track, 24-hour, supervisor and PPE modules under 29 CFR 1926.65.

SITEWORK/HAZ (https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40 HR Construction, 24 HR HAZWOPER, 8 HR Supervisor, 8 HR Refresher or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER for Construction (Contaminated Sites)](https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-construction-contaminated-sites): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The 40-hour initial HAZWOPER for construction workers on contaminated sites under 29 CFR 1926.65. Enroll: https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-construction-contaminated-sites?buy=588
- [OSHA 24 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training): $169.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). The 24-hour HAZWOPER for construction staff who are on contaminated sites only occasionally or in low-exposure areas. Enroll: https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=581
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Supervisor Training](https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training): $69.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(4). The 8-hour HAZWOPER supervisor course for foremen and superintendents running crews on contaminated sites. Enroll: https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training?buy=597
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $59.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). The annual 8-hour refresher that keeps construction crews' HAZWOPER certificates current. Enroll: https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595
- [HAZWOPER Micro-Module: PPE Levels A, B, C & D Explained](https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-ppe-levels-a-b-c-and-d-explained): $12.99 per seat, 15 Min, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). A 15-minute module on PPE levels, built for tailgate meetings. Enroll: https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-ppe-levels-a-b-c-and-d-explained?buy=585

## Guides

- [Does my construction crew need HAZWOPER?](https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/guides/does-my-construction-crew-need-hazwoper): Brownfields, landfills and contaminated excavations bring 1926.65 onto the job. Here's when it applies.
- [Excavating contaminated soil: what changes for the crew](https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/guides/excavating-contaminated-soil): Digging impacted soil is still digging. But air, skin and decon now matter as much as trench protection.
- [Working under the environmental contractor's health and safety plan](https://construction.hazwoperosha.us/guides/working-under-the-environmental-contractors-hasp): On remediation-driven projects, the site plan often isn't yours. Here's how to work inside it.
